title: Canonical open restriction of cotangent Ext and coefficient sheaves
statement: For $f:X\to S$ and an open $U\subset X$, open cotangent comparison data consist of the canonical base ring square for $U\to X$ and an isomorphism between restriction of the standard sheaf cotangent complex and the complex of $U\to S$. On each local standard section it is the map of polynomial differential complexes induced by that square, using the recorded tensor-versus-open-restriction isomorphism. Its Ext restriction is defined by the exact ordinary restriction functor on module sheaves, its derived shift and single-object comparisons, and the inverse of this cotangent isomorphism. The coefficient restriction is the composite of the recorded open tensor comparison with the inverse pullback-composition comparison, both for a general pulled-back base ideal and for $\mathcal O_X\otimes_kM$. Dependencies: [def-sfb-scheme-lift-classification-data], [def-pc-open-restricted-tensor-complex-iso], [lem-sc-derived-hom-mayer-vietoris], [lem-trf-lci-cotangent-presentation].
